problem_statement: In the fizzbuzz function, numbers divisible by both 3 and 5 (multiples of 15) currently return "Buzz" instead of "FizzBuzz". Fix the function so multiples of 15 return "FizzBuzz" by checking the condition for divisibility by 15 before the conditions for 3 or 5. Numbers divisible only by 3 should still return "Fizz", numbers divisible only by 5 should still return "Buzz", and other numbers should remain as integers.
